description: Refactor all dialog components to use a unified BaseDialog component instead of direct Vuetify dialog implementations. Ensure consistent dialog appearance and behavior across the application, with specific mobile optimizations including full-screen display on small screens and standardized action button placement.
functional_requirements: Replace all existing Vuetify v-dialog and v-card implementations with the BaseDialog component throughout the application
Implement responsive behavior where dialogs display in full-screen mode on mobile/small screen devices
Standardize dialog action buttons to always appear in a consistent location at the bottom of dialogs
Ensure all dialogs support consistent features including icons, titles, loading states, and action buttons
Update the bulk add dialog for ingredients, steps, and recipes to use simplified action button designs
Maintain backward compatibility with existing dialog functionality while improving UI consistency
